secrets.scope: Clean publication tree: git tracked and nonignored untracked files, copied with original bytes. Local .omp state, node_modules and .git are outside publication scope.
secrets.exceptions: Only eight exact synthetic HITL fixture fingerprints in .gitleaksignore; no general rule or path exemption.

limits: Scanner outputs are local and retained by hash; this record does not certify absence of every security defect.
Native OMP, hosted CI and release remain separate gates.
